texts.label: Jourdan to Soult, Madrid, 28 May 1812 (AHN DIVERSOS-COLECCIONES,134,N.34)
texts.summary: Eight weeks before the battle of Salamanca, Marshal Jourdan, King Joseph’s chief of staff, orders Soult to reinforce Count d’Erlon’s corps against General Hill, or to send it across the Tagus at the bridge of the Arzobispo if Wellington calls Hill back to him. The letter was intercepted: a contemporary Spanish translation survives in the Archivo Histórico Nacional, with the enciphered passages left as numbers, undeciphered. They read with the table of the 1812 Grand Chiffre.

reading_review.note: reading.md and decryption_N34.txt read against translation.md: the three cipher passages build coherent French sentences that run on from the Spanish clear text (Foy’s division recalled, three battalions and 800 horse left under Treillard; reinforce d’Erlon to beat Hill on the Guadiana or cross the Tagus at the Arzobispo to cover Madrid or the English right flank; correspondence with Treillard). The 8 restorations [x] and 9 probable readings are scattered, at most three in a sentence and all inside words whose sense is fixed; no number unresolved. Spot check of lines D1-D8 against image 2 at the published resolution: agrees, with two doubtful readings noted on the page (88 may be 58 = aux; 62 may be 64).

texts.label: Marmont to Jourdan, Salamanca, 1 June 1812 (AHN DIVERSOS-COLECCIONES,134,N.73)
texts.note: About 85% read; faulty Spanish copy. Working notes in French: reading_N73_partial.md.

reading_review.note: No translation and no established text in the folder, only the French working notes reading_N73_partial.md. Read as sentences: A1 (certitude absolue ... dans le Nord), B1 (J’écris itérativement au général Caffarelli ...), B2-B5 (Drouet to follow Hill’s movements; matériel d’artillerie à Talavera) are coherent; A2, A3 and B6 have several holes and guessed words. Coherent but raw, about 85%; it needs an English translation before the entry passes (draft in wu2/marmont1812_translation_N73_draft.md).

prior.where: N.73 (751): Scovell's manuscript decipherment (Oman V app. XV no. 28), not printed. N.34: not in the Scovell list; not printed in Du Casse (Mémoires du roi Joseph IX), Marmont's Mémoires IV, Jourdan's Mémoires militaires, Wellington's Dispatches IX or Supplementary Despatches VII (searched 28 Oct 2026). N.29 (724): contemporary Spanish decipherment in the piece.
